steps.text: Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid to start the quest.
choices: Are you really the greatest salesman in the world?
I'd like to help you, but...

steps.text: Buy a Kharidian Headpiece and a Fake Beard to create a disguise.
Create a disguise by using the Kharidian Headpiece on the Fake Beard.
Go through Shantay Pass.
Buy a shantay pass from Shantay.
Talk to the rug merchant and travel to Pollnivneach via magic carpet.
Buy 3 beers from the bartender and use them on Drunken Ali to get him to explain where his son is. Talk with him between beers
Talk to a Menaphite Thug to figure out how their dispute started with the bandits.
Talk to a bandit to figure out their issues with the Menaphites.
Talk to Ali the Camel Man to try and get two camels to solve the dispute
choices: Are those camels around the side for sale?
What price do you want for both of them?
Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?

steps.text: Tell the bandits that the Menaphites have agreed to return the camel.
Tell the Menaphites that the bandits have agreed to return the camel.
Talk to Ali the Operator to get a job from him.
choices: Yes, of course, those bandits should be taught a lesson.

steps.text: Pickpocket a villager.
Lure a villager then talk to a street urchin and get them to distract a villager, once he has them distracted pickpocket them from behind.
Equip your oak blackjack in your inventory.
Lure a villager to secluded place or an empty building, knock them out and then pickpocket them.
Talk to Ali the Operator to get the second job.
Hide behind the cactus
Open the door.
Go up the stairs.
Search the painting to reveal the safe. Enter the code 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8.
Go down the stairs.
Give Ali the Operator the jewels to get your final task from him.
Talk to a Menaphite member to find the traitor.
Talk to Ali and tell him you have found the traitor.
Talk to Ali the Barman to find out where Traitorous Ali is.
Talk to Ali the Hag to ask her to make some poison for you.
Use coins on the snake charmer's money pot to get a snake charm and a snake basket.
Use the Snake Charm on a snake to capture it.
Give the snake to Ali the Hag.
Talk to Ali the Kebab Salesman to get a special sauce to use.
choices: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?

steps.text: Pick up a bucket to grab the dung
Use the bucket on the dung.

Use the Red Hot Sauce on the Trough and wait for a Camel to poop out the dung.
 Only pickup brown/Ugthanki dung, if you plan to do "My Arm's Big Adventure" or "Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf" then you may want to grab four more Ugthanki dung.
Talk to Ali the Hag and give her the dung.
Use the poison on the beer glass to kill Traitorous Ali.
Talk to Ali the Operator and tell him he is dead.
Kill the Menaphite Thug. You can safespot him inside the tent by using a chair, if he's not spawned then talk to the Menaphite Leader again.
Talk to the Menaphite Leader and prepare for a fight against a tough guy. You can safespot him inside the tent by using a chair.
Talk to a villager and they will be angry you broke the balance of power.
Talk to the Bandit Leader and be prepared to fight a Bandit Champion. You can safe spot him with the stool.

Kill the Bandit Champion, you can safe spot him with the stool. 
 If he's not spawned then talk to the Bandit Leader again.
Talk to a villager and they will be angry still.
Talk to Ali the Mayor and get your due congratulations.
Talk to  Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid to finish the quest.
